fixtures.name: array-ctor-new-vs-from-noop
fixtures.rationale: SIG-478: new Array(n) and Array.from({length:n}) build the same length-n array for every valid length; they diverge ONLY on an out-of-domain length (n=-1: new Array(-1) throws RangeError but Array.from({length:-1}) returns []). That sole divergence is an array-constructor idiom artifact, not the cited bug, so isArrayCtorOnlyRewrite returns inconclusive ('array-ctor-rewrite') BEFORE the battery -- it must NOT reproduce. No-fill form chosen so source reconstruction lifts a clean same-arity buggy/fixed pair (a .fill(0) form's suggestedReplacement carries a ()=>0 arrow the locator lifts as the fixed fn -> vacuous arity-mismatch skip).

fixtures.name: array-ctor-untyped-new-vs-from-noop

These are NOT host-errors, so an error-message-only refinement still falsely reproduces this case. The expression-level detector is param-type-independent and keeps it inconclusive -- this fixture is the regression guard locking in the type-independent resolution.
